The company announced on Monday morning that the board "voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang's candor and ability to lead NVIDIA." item.title: Review: Blade Runner 2099 is an inventive twist on a cyberpunk classic
item.description: In an age of streaming shows designed to appeal to distracted viewers, Blade Runner 2099 can feel like a welcome anachronism.
